summary: Expose unresolved native effects and require explicit person-authorized confirmation or abandonment

replay.detail: Native message recovery reads by key and never re-originates; restart and lease churn do not clear unresolved fences.

schema.detail: Existing effect.confirmed receipts gain optional human resolution/outcome fields; the registry-shaped convergence corpus advances to v33 while v32 is preserved. Adds an idempotently created step-effect lookup index; no new claim kind, table or schema-version change.

compatibility.detail: Adds effect by-key read and explicit resolution endpoints, effects status/resolve CLI commands, and additive run-view effect observations. Absent optional wire fields are omitted.

manual.detail: Unresolved effects require an authenticated person to confirm the result with evidence or explicitly abandon it; timeouts never transfer origination authority.

recovery.detail: Unresolved episodes surface once in attention and faults, and remain fenced until covered by explicit human resolution.
